title: MxAgile Project Configuration
description: Project-level MxAgile configuration. Agents read mxagile-project.yaml in the project root to determine UI-driven mode, concern-specific source authority, and fidelity requirements. If the file is absent all defaults apply and existing MxAgile behavior is preserved.

ui_driven.description: When true the mockup is the authoritative delivery reference for configured UI concerns. Discovery must find and process all HTML mockups. Implementation follows the UI inventory as a binding contract. Verification enforces fidelity.

source_authority.description: Per-concern source authority. Each concern is resolved independently; a source does not globally override another source. Only conflicts within the same concern and no configured winner produce DECISION REQUIRED.

ui_interaction.description: Interaction behavior: field behaviour, button enablement, visible state transitions.

business_logic.description: Business rules, mandatory field semantics, calculations, status transitions.

data_rules.description: Data types, constraints, validation rules, entity definitions.

fidelity.description: standard: UI-Agent Verify checks structural field/button presence. high: additionally verifies semantic layout (section grouping, element ordering, component types, navigation flows, interaction states, visual hierarchy).
